transcript:
Customer: Hi, I need a quote for custom t-shirts.
Morpheus: I'd be happy to help with that. Can you tell me what type of garments you're looking for?
Customer: T-shirts, about 50 pieces.
Morpheus: Got it. And how many print locations?
Customer: Front and back.
Morpheus: Perfect. When do you need these by?
Customer: Next Friday.
Morpheus: I'll have the team send you a quote. Can I get your name and email?
Customer: John Smith, john@example.com
Morpheus: Thanks John. The team will follow up via email with your quote.

analysis.summary: Customer requested quote for 50 custom t-shirts with front and back printing, needed by next Friday
